subject: Exec update: Optimize Suggestions (Console) beta — status, risks, and expected KPI impact
body:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 8:12 AM
Subject: Exec update: Optimize Suggestions (Console) beta — status, risks, and expected KPI impact

Team — quick weekly exec update on Suggestions (Console) beta. Goal is to keep this crisp: where we are, what could go wrong, and what we expect to see in adoption metrics.

1) Current status (as of Feb 10)
- Build: Read-only Suggestions view (list + detail drawer) is in prod behind suggestions_beta + per-tenant allowlist.
- Backend: suggestions-service list/detail endpoints live; savings estimate v1 + risk level stub shipping with rationale + “basis of estimate” fields.
- Console: Feature-flag gating + allowlist checks are enforced in BFF + UI; RBAC for view access is enabled; audit log entries for access are in place.
- Telemetry: Impression/open events are flowing for “viewed/opened/filter applied” (privacy-safe).
- Beta cohort: We have 6 tenants enabled in prod, 3 more pending final CS scheduling this week.

2) What’s working / early signal
- CS/SE feedback: The detail drawer is doing the work—customers immediately ask “how did you compute this?” and we have an answer now (baseline window, token mix, cache hit-rate assumptions, etc.).
- Design: Risk chip + rationale bullets are reducing back-and-forth vs the earlier “High risk” label alone.
- Performance: Console page load and table interactions are within budget in staging and prod so far.

3) Key risks / mitigations (the things that would force us to pause)
A) Trust gap: estimated vs realized savings mismatch
- Risk: If week-to-week savings swings or doesn’t match observed bills, we lose credibility and adoption stalls.
- Mitigation: (1) suppress suggestions when telemetry is stale/insufficient, (2) show confidence intervals + basis, (3) prioritize fixes in metering baseline pipeline.
- Pause criteria: repeated customer reports of >30% mismatch in top suggestions without explainable telemetry changes.

B) Recommendation-induced regressions (latency/quality)
- Risk: customers follow a suggestion, see p95 latency spikes or quality deltas, and generalize that Optimize is unsafe.
- Mitigation: guardrails suppress certain suggestions; risk taxonomy is conservative in beta; we’re requiring eval coverage for “higher leverage” batching suggestions.
- Pause criteria: any confirmed incident attributable to a suggested config change where risk was labeled Low/Medium.

C) Isolation / scoping issues
- Risk: any cross-tenant visibility in Suggestions is a hard stop.
- Mitigation: tenant scoping checks + audit logging already shipped; security review completed; oncall will page on anomalous access patterns.
- Pause criteria: any verified scoping bug in prod.

D) “No suggestions” / insufficient data confusion
- Risk: customers perceive the feature as broken, not “waiting on telemetry.”
- Mitigation: improved empty states + explicit “what data is missing” messaging; Support FAQ updated.

4) Expected KPI impact (beta outcomes we should see if we’re on track)
Baseline problem: today, Optimize adoption is bottlenecked by expertise and time. Customers often need an SE to interpret and tune batching/caching, and it’s not obvious where to start.

We expect Suggestions to move these leading indicators in the beta cohort (measured weekly):
- Time-to-first-optimization action: down from ~2–3 weeks post-onboarding to <7 days (via clearer “start here” recommendations).
- Optimize engagement: +20–30% lift in weekly Console sessions touching Optimize surfaces (Suggestions page + related dashboards).
- Trust signals (proxy): higher detail-drawer open rate and lower support ticket volume per enabled tenant after week 2.

Note: Since beta is read-only, our primary measurable outcomes are “viewed/opened” and qualitative confirmation of intent. Realized savings attribution will be directionally tracked, but we should not over-rotate on realized $ until we have an apply workflow + better counterfactuals.

5) Next 7 days (owners)
- Telemetry freshness gating: align on hard threshold for showing savings when baseline is older than N hours (Logan/Nadia + Dylan).
- Risk scoring calibration: incorporate long-context workload variance signals where we’ve seen misclassification (Jonas/Karthik + Hassan).
- Support readiness: final FAQ + escalation path; template responses for “why did savings change?” (Dev/Rachel + Marissa).
- Cohort enablement: move 3 pending tenants from “approved” to “enabled + walkthrough scheduled” (Jasmine/Miguel/Aparna).

If helpful, I can roll this into a single dashboard view for leadership (enabled tenants, usage, trust signals, top open risks). For now, I’m keeping this in email so it’s hard to ignore.

— Evelyn


From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 9:01 AM
Subject: Re: Exec update: Optimize Suggestions (Console) beta — status, risks, and expected KPI impact

+1 to keeping realized $ as a “directional” metric in read-only.

One ask: can we add a simple weekly “top 3 reasons suggestions were suppressed” breakdown? It’ll keep us honest on telemetry/guardrails and will help explain the “no suggestions” cases to CS.

Aditya


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 11:03 AM
Subject: Re: Exec update: Optimize Suggestions (Console) beta — status, risks, and expected KPI impact

Agree on suppression breakdown — we can log suppression reason codes at generation time and expose an internal-only metric for the beta.

Also: we should explicitly message in the UI that savings ranges can move when baselines refresh (and that this is expected). Support is already seeing early confusion on “why did it change?” even when the direction is stable.

Marissa
